# Test PDFs

reading.pdf, different.pdf, broken.pdf: generated locally by scripts/make-fixtures.mjs for integration tests.
encrypted.pdf: Mozilla PDF.js test/pdfs/pr6531_1.pdf, downloaded from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mozilla/pdf.js/master/test/pdfs/pr6531_1.pdf.
Upstream tests and password: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/test/unit/api_spec.js.
PDF.js project license: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/LICENSE (Apache-2.0).
No personal documents are included.
